linkHint: Close it and this tab opens your link.
linkTaken: Your link opened in Property in your other tab.
linkTakenHint: Carry on there. You can close this one.
lockdown: Lockdown Mode looks to be on, and it turns off what Property needs. Turn it off for this site, then reload.
lockdownHow: How to turn it off for this site
lockdownOtherBrowser: Other browsers on iPhone or iPad: Settings › Privacy & Security › Lockdown Mode › Configure Web Browsing, and turn it off for that browser.
lockdownSafari: Safari: tap aA in the address bar, then Website Settings, and turn Lockdown Mode off (on a Mac: Safari › Settings for This Website).
missingCrypto: Web Crypto is off. It works only on a secure (https) address.
missingIndexedDB: IndexedDB is off or blocked, so chats and keys can't be saved.
missingLocks: Web Locks is missing, so Property can't make sure it runs only once.
missingStorage: Site data is blocked, so nothing can be saved.
otherTab: Property is already open in another tab.
otherTabHint: Close it and this tab takes over.
reloadUnreachable: Can't reach Property's server. Check your connection, then reload.
shared: Sent to Property in your other tab.
sharedHint: Pick the chat there. You can close this one.
title: Property can't run in this browser
tryOther: Leave private mode and allow site data, update the browser, or open Property in another one.
trySecure: Open Property at its https:// address.
